The reproducible Elo benchmark for Deep Research agents.面向 Deep Research 智能体的可复现 Elo 基准。

Twelve open-source research agents run against the same frozen sandbox. The board separates report quality from evidence quality: every cited URL is fetched, every quoted passage is checked, and the public score only rises when both hold up.十二个开源研究智能体在同一套冻结沙箱中运行。榜单把报告质量与证据质量分开：每个引用 URL 都会被抓取，每段引文都会被核对；只有两者都站得住，公开主分才会上升。

Truth-gated leaders真值门控领跑者

Claude Code(1032) and OpenCode(975) lead on truth-gated Elo (judge Elo × grounding gate).Claude Code(1032) 与 OpenCode(975) 领跑真值门控 Elo（判官 Elo × 接地门）。

Most decisive wins最具决定性的胜场

Claude Code took (304) wins out of 566 battles — the most decisive performer.Claude Code 在 566 场对战中赢下 (304) 场，是最具决定性的选手。

Most grounded最扎实的接地

OpenCode has the most real evidence: (94%) of its cited URLs actually resolve in the sandbox.OpenCode 的证据最真实：其引用的 URL 有 (94%) 在沙箱中真实可达。

Tightest confidence最窄置信区间

OpenCode has the narrowest 95% CI (±(39.3)) — its rank is the most stable across bootstraps.OpenCode 拥有最窄的 95% 置信区间 (±(39.3))，其排名在多次自助采样中最为稳定。

Judge vs grounding判官 vs 接地

A high raw judge score can still hide weak evidence. The public score keeps that visible by multiplying judge preference by reachable, verified citations.高裸判官分仍可能掩盖薄弱证据。公开主分把这一点显式保留下来： 判官偏好必须乘以可达且可核验的引用。

Whiskers are 95% bootstrap CIs on a clipped axis: non-overlapping whiskers mean the judge separates the two agents reliably. The judge draws ~50% of battles, which compresses raw Elo -- the grounding gate, not the judge, is what spreads the headline ranking.须线为 95% 自助置信区间（坐标轴已裁剪到主簇）：须线不重叠即表示判官能可靠区分两者。判官约 50% 的对战判为平局，因此裸 Elo 本身偏紧 -- 真正拉开主榜差距的是接地门，而不是判官。

How are these scores computed?这些分数是如何计算的？

Two measurements are kept separate: grounding checks whether cited URLs resolve and whether quoted evidence appears on the cited page; judge Elo measures pairwise report quality across 2,615 battles with bootstrap confidence intervals. The public score multiplies the two, so unsupported polish cannot dominate the board.两个测量保持分离：接地核验检查引用 URL 是否可达、引文是否出现在被引页面；判官 Elo 通过 2,615 场两两对战衡量报告质量，并给出自助置信区间。公开主分将二者相乘，因此缺乏证据支撑的漂亮报告无法占据榜首。
